prompts.task: Audit the live agent app in ./service for GenAI instrumentation and content/semantic coverage. Use genai-default-scenarios.json to also assess existing OTel, existing Galileo and export-only live-agent snapshots. Determine the appropriate default producer for each scenario without asking me to choose a library. Produce the normal validated canonical audit/HTML for the live app and a concise .observe/genai-default-scenarios.md mapping each snapshot to its producer, exact remaining fields, applicability and proof plan. Useful bounded redacted content is required; do not modify application/dependency/config/test files or contact models/cloud. Treat app.py and each producer source snapshot as separate source cases. Also explicitly assess genai-required-evidence.json as a separate captured synthetic case, including safe-call-1, the independent auxiliary request timeout with no ended inference/error span, ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers, and HTTP200 with rejectedSpans1; those facts do not establish that app.py contains those operations. Use genai-sdk-source-snapshot.json and genai-semconv-source-snapshot.json as dated official-source evidence when this sandbox cannot access the network. Record exact file paths, resolved revisions and capture dates, proposed SDK compatibility and the distinction between a captured-main snapshot and a new live latest lookup. Do not claim unavailable installed/runtime or future-main proof. Assess actual content and requirements across the artifacts in any concise equivalent structure; a table heading alone is not evidence. Canonical live findings and acceptance must bind concrete proposed numeric message, part, and UTF-8 capture limits to a named source file/function or explicitly proposed sanitizer hook at the real boundary before SDK logging and every exporter; unknown active policy remains unproven rather than invented. For each separate source scenario, explicitly assess its known temperature and stream request flags; for the separate captured synthetic case, assess its available separate agent instructions and offered tool definitions without attributing those fields to app.py. Give per-operation and per-field official OTel requirement levels, including Opt-In, distinct from this skill's required safe-content and vendor acceptance; state the vendor INTERNAL-agent provider expectation and source-specific INTERNAL/CLIENT span-kind requirements. Preserve existing producer/provider/export paths, report scope, unrun-runtime limits, and the actual dated SDK/source-snapshot provenance; do not invent unavailable values or unsupported attributes. Record at least one concrete official SDK example file path present inside genai-sdk-source-snapshot.json, such as examples/logging-samples/splunk-ao-logger/basic-example.py, and bind the cited example to that snapshot's resolved revision/capture date and an explicitly proposed or verified installed SDK version/API compatibility. The snapshot container JSON path alone is not an example-file receipt; keep uninspected installed/runtime support Not proven. Also read genai-sdk-helper-audit-snapshot.json as separately supplied installed-package source and synthetic in-memory producer/capture evidence. Review documented public creator alternatives and their actual signatures before declaring a logger-only sink/registration limitation a blocker for every operation. The live interactive app has no selected AO target, and eval_runner.py remains a separate process; assess normal fresh-default audit behavior from that state. Keep actual installed-helper capture separate from app.py, proposed implementation and unexecuted receiver/resource/cloud proof. Do not modify or import the supplied snapshots.

judge_inputs: Inspect app.py, eval_runner.py, the unchanged provided source/telemetry snapshots, loaded skill sources and generated .observe reports/plan; evaluate actual per-scenario decisions and field assessments, not copied skill wording.

Evaluate the actual facts across canonical and supplemental artifacts, not exact headings/table layout. Compare app.py source separately from each synthetic input case. Dated official snapshots are allowed offline provenance; do not demand live network calls, installed SDK proof for a proposed plan, or fabricated existing capture configuration. Do not score missing SDK provenance again under the final role-specific criterion.

Inspect genai-sdk-helper-audit-snapshot.json as independent installed-package/producer/in-memory capture evidence, with exact versions and source hashes. Do not turn its demonstrated fields into app.py runtime coverage. Check canonical live AO finding_group, resource-target eligibility marker/configuration scope, acceptance scenarios and HTML group, rather than only supplemental prose. Missing selected cloud identity is an unproven resource/routing state, not evidence that fresh-default AO adoption is outside scope.

Check canonical live findings and acceptance plus each separate source scenario for actual operation counts/parentage and newly proposed gen_ai attributes. A schema-helper capability or SDK/vendor grouping is not evidence of another source workflow. Inspect genai-semconv-source-snapshot.json for reserved attribute definitions; distinguish newly invented standard fields from proven existing custom/legacy aliases and app/vendor derived totals.
rubric: Selects Splunk AO span creation by default for the actual fresh interactive agent and export-only-fresh snapshot, while preserving existing OTel and Galileo GenAI producers/provider/export paths and filling only their gaps. Evaluation-only SDK usage and generic HTTP/provider setup do not establish live GenAI coverage.

Treats applicable safe content and vendor fields as required acceptance, preserving official Opt-In provenance. Per operation identifies source availability, concrete proposed numeric message/part/UTF-8 limits or a known stricter policy and a named boundary before every SDK/exporter for redaction. Source-unavailable values have exact reasons and acceptance tests. Generic bounded/redacted wording alone is insufficient; metadata-only, placeholders, fabricated zeros and forbidden raw content never close coverage. When the existing policy is unknown, mark configuration unproven and bind a concrete proposed policy and named source hook to canonical live findings/acceptance; do not invent active configuration or leave limits only in a generic supplemental statement.

Reconciles the supplied dated official OTel requirements/schemas with both Galileo and Splunk AO recommendation sources, identifying exact source provenance and unavailable newer live freshness honestly. Keeps OTel Opt-In levels distinct from the required skill profile, states vendor INTERNAL-agent provider and tool arguments/input-message plus result/output-message mappings or supported OpenInference equivalents, and uses current typed-parts schemas. Embedded system-role history is not fabricated as separate API instructions. Do not fail only because equivalent evidence appears in prose or another artifact instead of a specific table.

Names source-backed supported Splunk AO logger, schema/decorator, public start_splunk_ao_span, or matching framework creators at actual fresh agent/model/tool/applicable workflow boundaries, and preserves exact existing hooks for instrumented cases. Records a concrete official example file path, snapshot or live resolved revision/date and a matching installed or explicitly proposed SDK version/API. The supplied dated official-main snapshot is valid offline source evidence when identified as such; live networking and successful SDK installation are not required in this task. Unknown live freshness/runtime support remains Not proven. A directory URL or an unsupported claim that latest main was checked is insufficient; processor-only setup does not create GenAI operations. Examines the supplied public helper source/signature and independent capture before generalizing missing private logger-sink registration into a blanket external blocker. Recognizes writable same-tool-span input/output enrichment and the successful-null OpenInference alternative from their actual captured fields, while preserving the separate named LlmSpan INTERNAL/no-kind-argument limitation for a genuinely separate-process CLIENT model; does not invent a kind parameter, duplicate model node, or declare every SDK operation fully compliant.

Assesses each source case and the separate captured-evidence case without laundering fixture facts into app.py. Preserves one producer/node and actual parentage, safe tool-call/conversation correlation on spans, actual offered definitions and arguments/results, and error/cancel/teardown handling. App.py may correctly have no independent auxiliary operation, but the supplied synthetic auxiliary timeout with no ended inference/error span must be reported as a lifecycle gap. safe-call-1 requires span-only correlation; ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers are GenAI N/A. Equivalent explicit lifecycle evidence is accepted without a literal table-row requirement; absent runtime proof remains Not proven. Studio/gateway, live credentials and SDK source edits are unnecessary.

Promotes applicable live missing content/vendor fields and producer gaps into executable canonical findings, expected telemetry and acceptance scenarios with correct selection scope. Supplemental snapshot/captured-case gaps stay distinct from live source findings. Does not require a retrieval query/document or nested operation from a constant-returning search_docs stub without actual search dataflow. Source/API support and live delivery stay unproven where unavailable; evaluate this binding/outcome criterion without double-counting SDK source provenance.

Fresh default Splunk AO adoption is assessed in canonical findings even without an explicit user AO request, installed live SDK, credentials or selected target. Missing live project, dedicated Agent Stream and runtime routing appear as distinct executable configuration findings under finding_group=splunk-agent-observability, with correct dependency/selection binding, resource-routing target eligibility, expected telemetry and acceptance scenarios; the rendered HTML exposes the AO group. Optional user Project/Agent Stream name or ID choices and disclosed stable proposed defaults do not auto-select work, fabricate existing resources or imply cloud authorization. Canonical acceptance covers the named launch profile loading before SDK import/initialization, reuse of both existing resources without creates, ordered creation of conclusively missing selected names, mixed existing/missing state, repeated-run reuse, bounded exact duplicate-conflict and uncertain-create relookup, lookup-only supplied IDs that are never recreated, explicit ID ownership and stream/project association validation, and auth/transport/5xx failures that never become absence. Resource lookup/create/routing proof remains distinct from local trace receipt and fresh cloud Agent Stream visibility. Existing evaluation-only AO resources do not close interactive scope, and unsupported runtime/API behavior stays explicitly Not proven without blocking the read-only audit or erasing actionable independent findings.

Binds one orchestration node to each actual source boundary in the canonical live findings, expected telemetry and acceptance, as well as the separate producer scenarios. app.py build_turn and the export-only turn -> client.chat snapshot do not establish a separate workflow plus agent boundary: calls to models/tools, HTTP/SSE wrappers or SDK trace grouping alone must not invent another invoke_workflow/invoke_agent node. Distinct workflow and agent nodes are accepted only with distinct source-backed operations. Reconciles newly proposed reserved gen_ai.* attributes with the supplied current official registry; does not introduce gen_ai.usage.total_tokens into fresh canonical telemetry or acceptance when the registry provides input/output counts. Useful derived totals may use an application/vendor-owned namespace with their calculation and estimate/actual provenance stated. Preserves and labels any actually supplied existing vendor/legacy aliases rather than deleting consumer behavior. Assess canonical outcomes, not only a general guardrail in supplemental prose; otherwise correct AO grouping or creator selection does not excuse invented operation nodes or reserved attributes.
